summary: 1955 Alabama Forestry Commission International Derrick fire tower, one of few 120-foot examples, in Jackson County; NHLR-registered 2009. Staffing, condition and access unsourced.

notes_for_editor: One source for the build year, design, agency and registration: the NHLR entry, read in full (it names Alabama Forestry Commission as administrator). The 1819 News article is general background and does not name Fabius. Not found: staffing, fire history, condition today, access, and any dated source for the record's 'standing' status (the Register does not state it). A search surfaced the Joe B. Shirley tower near Huntsville in Madison County, a different tower, excluded. The 120 ft height (36.6 m) is the Register's figure and may not be cab-floor height. 'Internatioinal' is a typo in the Register, not in our text.
